alarms.subject: family:coverage_judge
alarms.why: refused all of its last 8 verdicts across 6 items

gaps.criterion_why: The contract defines hold as whether a scene stays up for his review, and a leaf that names his part needs a scene that stays up for it.
gaps.observed: tree.json gives owner_part 'yes: inspect the forest at play zoom', 'yes: watch the connected over-water burn', 'yes: perform the resumed work and second action order' and four more; all 35 scenes carry "hold": "immediate". Every entry hash matches the round-1 verdict, so this is still open.

smallest_fix.what: scenes.json: set hold 'owner_review' on the seven named scenes, stating the keeper save and review end; or edit tree.json owner_part where his look is not actually wanted

gaps.what: Seven leaves whose owner_part says he inspects, judges or performs have no scene held for his review: every scene is hold 'immediate'.
gaps.where: scenes.json (every scene's hold field) against tree.json owner_part
gaps.would_pass: For each of the seven leaves, at least one of its acceptance scenes (arrival_identity, falter_hour, ambient_routes, gas_chain, gas_displacement, routine_day, resume_walk) has hold 'owner_review' with a keeper save and a named review end; or the leaf's owner_part reads 'no' with a recorded reason. A script can check that every owner_part 'yes' leaf has an owner_review scene.

gaps.criterion_why: The judging brief requires the sheet to say what the tree tests, and a leaf missing from it is checkable.
gaps.observed: sheet.md 'does' has 15 leaf lines and none is [leaf:cauldron_walk]; the walk appears only under 'pruning'. sheet.md:18 says only 'Wild vexxiss compete for vents and pry ordinary taps; lined taps resist, while tame shearing supplies vexxith', while the leaf adds 'Water poisoning and fire response remain distinct causal behaviors' and leaves tracks to water_fire_tracks. exam.json passed 30/30 on this sheet, so the exam did not catch the omission.

smallest_fix.what: sheet.md: add a cauldron_walk line; extend the vent_competition line

gaps.what: The sheet a player reads omits what the tree tests: the walk leaf is missing from 'does', and the vent_competition line omits the water poisoning, fire-warden response and tracks that its leaf and scenes test.
gaps.would_pass: sheet.md 'does' carries a [leaf:cauldron_walk] line stating resume, repeat and second order, and the vent_competition line names water poisoning, fire response to igniters and tracks. A script can check that every tree leaf of kind experience or walk has a 'does' line.

reasons: Nothing has changed since the round-1 verdict (rm-coverage-judge-1794838039). Every per-entry hash, and the input hashes of scenes.json, record.json, sheet.md, exam.json and floor.json, match exactly, and there is no coverage_fixes.json. So all twelve round-1 gaps are still open (unfixed). Each one is still accurate when checked against the text. Structurally, coverage holds: all 67 mandatory units are in a showcase or in coverage_rest (checked by script, none uncovered). Every scene is script-staged with an entry-point item, an asserted start, a control with rules_out, and restore. The greedy order and overlap of the showcases is within the rules. The flagship was picked by the Conductor under the Evidence-for-Ask and Conductor-authority rulings, and I did not count that as a gap. Two late misses are added: the walk's 'risky expeditions' clause has no arm in resume_walk, and zisska herd, vexxiss art and gas section rendering appear only in scene actions. All 14 gaps can be fixed by the Designer at stage 3 with scenes.json, tree.json and sheet.md edits; none needs his answer. Not checked: whether the painted or delivered pool site that pool_identity requires exists yet (it is a delivery question, not coverage).
